svg.title: Blue Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Blue convex form grows from full left edge to touch right edge; white upper/lower-right painted regions retained. Actual museum 2016 checklist thumbnail, not another Blue Curve numbered series. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for blue, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
